spec.claim_summary: Long BTC on 4H when Supertrend flips from downtrend to uptrend with an ATR stop, a 0.75R first partial profit, and remaining position exited when Supertrend flips back to downtrend.
assumptions: BTCUSD mapped to Binance spot symbol BTCUSDT.
Supertrend change from downtrend to uptrend compiled as close crosses_above supertrend; change from uptrend to downtrend as close crosses_below supertrend.
Supertrend settings not stated so indicator defaults used: ATR length 10 and multiplier 3.
ATR stop-loss multiplier not stated so 2.0 used.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit of half position at 0.75R - schema exits full position only, so no fixed target is set and the core holding to Supertrend flip is tested.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving the ATR stop to breakeven after the 0.75R half-profit is taken.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim requires closing half the position at 0.75R; spec sets take_profit_r null and holds full position to opposite Supertrend flip. Marked NOT EXPRESSIBLE but omission changes returns/win-rate.

exit[1]: Claim requires moving ATR stop to breakeven after 0.75R half-profit is taken; spec omits this and keeps original ATR stop. Marked NOT EXPRESSIBLE but omission changes loss profile and verdict.
